source.label: Reddit, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2024
source.quote: Our corporate headquarters is located in San Francisco, California, where we lease approximately 48,000 square feet of office space pursuant to a lease agreement that expires in 2029

notes: FY2024 10-K only. The 10-K gives the U.S. headcount (1,768 of 2,233); the non-U.S. remainder was not derived. Item 2 also mentions leased offices in New York, Chicago, Los Angeles and London without detail, so they are not listed as sites. No state or tax-by-country data is published.
